sonnet.problem: Story card 5 already says 'Seven days from now, He will send rain on the earth.' That tells the baker the whole claim in this true/false statement, so the answer is given away and the same fact is asked about twice.
sonnet.rule: No card ever gives away the answer to a choice card that comes later. ... Two lines that make the same point get one question.

sonnet.problem: The question's setup says 'the waters completely prevail upon the earth.' That wording rules out the wrong answers ('tops of the trees', 'halfway up the high hills') and points to the right one.
sonnet.rule: A setup line can't rule out the wrong answers either.
